svg.text: V7 — all pose couplings OFF (gastrocnemius / hamstring / screw-home / hip rotation) — foot_R (drop1m, V2-REF)
angles (deg): foot pitch (+ heel up), shank tilt (+ top toward the toes), ankle DF (+) / PF (−), knee flexion / 3
angular velocity (rad/s): ankle DF (+ dorsiflexing), foot pitch rate, shank pitch rate
external force on the foot (N, clipped −500…1500; impact tick ≈ 27 kN; includes any self-contact)
centre of pressure along the boot (0 heel rear → 1 toe tip; shown while Fy > 20 N); ankle at 0.23
horizontal offset ankle − CoP along the foot (mm; 0 = the turf force passes under the ankle: torque-free strut)
boot pieces in turf contact (piece index: 0–1 heel row … 8–9 toe row)
torques about the ankle (N·m; DF-sign for the ankle rows; contact moment + = heel-up, clipped ±200)
work on the foot after the impact tick, cumulative (J): Δ(KE + PE) = point + rows + external (impact tick itself: point 202 J, turf -211 J)
ankle elastic energy U (J) and cumulative ankle drive work on the joint (J)
